Farah Patel
farah.patel@example.com | Columbus, OH
Farah Patel has 9 years of experience in backend and distributed systems. Most
recently, Staff Backend Engineer at Quartzline Labs (2023-2026), where they
introduced Terraform-managed infrastructure, cutting provisioning time by 45%.
Before that, Senior Backend Engineer at Harborlight Software (2017-2023).
Education: M.S. Computer Engineering, DePaul University, 2017; B.S. Computer
Engineering, Drexel University, 2014. Core skills: MySQL, Kafka, AWS, Redis,
TypeScript, Node.js, Distributed systems, PostgreSQL, Microservices, GraphQL,
Kubernetes.
